title: How Many Tiles Cover a 7 by 9 Floor?
description: A real-world reason multiplying rows by columns beats counting one by one.
narration_lines: You're tiling a floor that's seven tiles by nine tiles. How many tiles total?
Picture the floor as a grid, seven rows and nine columns.
Instead of counting one by one, just multiply the rows by the columns.
Seven times nine is sixty three tiles, no counting required.
